thread:
Alex W: Quick sync — following the authz postmortem, we need to lock down the closure cadence and make sure secrets rotation is on a recurring schedule. Low-friction plan pls.
Maria P: Agreed. I sketched a short remediation cadence: ack -> owner assign -> 7d fix -> 30d verification -> 90d audit. Can share owners next. :white_check_mark:
Nisha R: That cadence sounds good. We should include a light signal for recurring patterns so we can catch regressions across incidents. Maybe an automated tag in the incident record.
Jack L: +1. Also call out audit-logging gaps we saw (partial logs for token exchange). Who takes ownership of the logging fix?
Alex W: @Nisha R to own audit logging fix (investigate missing fields, add guardrail). @Jack L to own secrets rotation policy + implement rotation job. I'll own the cadence process and ensure follow-ups.
Nisha R: I'll start with a reproducible checklist: 1) reproduce missing fields, 2) add unit/regression test, 3) update ingest schema, 4) deploy and validate. Target: triage by 48h, patch in 7d.
Jack L: For secrets rotation I'm proposing a staggered rotation with canary: rotate service tokens on dev -> staging -> prod over 72h window, with health-check and fallback. I'll put a CR with runbook.
Maria P: We need to track action items in a single place. Proposal: use the incidents tracker + a recurring calendar reminder for owners. I can make a Google Sheet and a daily digest bot that pings owners if overdue. Thoughts?
Alex W: Good. Let's standardize the tracker fields: incident_id, root_cause, remediation_owner, target_date, verification_owner, verification_date, recurrence_flag, pattern_tag.
SRE-Bot: New checklist created: https://tracker.internal/INC-2026-47/checklist (owner: Alex W)
Nisha R: One more ask — add an automated baseline test for token validation to the CI matrix. I can draft a test that runs a simulated token exchange and asserts audit log fields. Snippet: ```python
resp = client.exchange_token(old, new)
assert 'exchange_id' in resp.audit
```
Jack L: I'll add the rotation job. Cron looks like: `0 2 * * 1 /opt/rotations/rotate-secrets --env=staging --canary` and a small wrapper that fails-open to previous key if healthcheck fails.
Maria P: I'll build the sheet with the tracker columns and add initial rows for this incident and for the two prior authz incidents to detect patterns. Will share by EOD.
Alex W: TL;DR action items: (A) Nisha - audit logging fix, triage 48h, patch 7d. (B) Jack - secrets rotation job + runbook, CR this week, rollouts next week. (C) Maria - tracker + daily digest, sheet by EOD. (D) Alex - cadence + verify recurrence tagging + follow-up check at 30d and 90d.
Nisha R: Leaving notes in the incident: reproducer + test plan. @Alex W can you add the recurrence_tag to the incident record?
Alex W: Done — tagged INC-2026-47 with `recurrence:authz-token`. Also created a 30d and 90d follow-up task in the tracker.
Jack L: I pushed a draft CR for the rotation job: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/1243 - review welcome.
Maria P: Sheet shared: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example - added the two prior incidents and a column for "pattern_notes". Please populate verification results there.
SRE-Bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check in 30 days (1768737234).
Alex W: Thanks team. Let's review status in next on-call sync if anything slips. :thumbsup:
Maria P: Thanks, closing loop here once verification passes.
Nisha R: I'll ping when the audit logs are validated.
Jack L: Will run the canary rotation tomorrow morning with the wrapper and report results here.
